author: barnabemonnot
content:
Latency is a variable, but throughput is another. Trading off throughput against latency is a choice that we can make. In my view, we should get slot times to the lowest possible given physical constraints of round-the-world latencies, and bank on improving proving efficiency to increase throughput over time.

We can also make the choice to allow throughput far beyond what a consumer GPU can prove, as long as we’re reasonably confident it doesn’t lead to centralisation leading to rent or liveness issues (see https://ethresear.ch/t/decoupling-throughput-from-local-building/22004).
